name: External System Member Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the membership of a party in a system, as published in an external system member type code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

DRCT.name: Direct
DRCT.definition: Member has full rights in the system. In principle, this membership status entails financial responsibility for its own operations and sponsored members' operations submitted to the system.

IDRT.name: Indirect
IDRT.definition: Member has limited rights in the system specifications. In principle, this membership status entails no financial responsibility for its operations submitted to the system.

RMTE.name: Remote
RMTE.definition: Member has access to the system from a remote location or through remote technical means.

EURO.name: EURO 1
EURO.definition: Member is entitled to access the Euro1 system of the Euro Banking Association (EBA).

STEP.name: STEP 1
STEP.definition: Member is entitled to access the Step1 system of the Euro Banking Association (EBA).
